rca_of_issue: Previously connections.pair was a multikey (array) unique index, so Mongo's unique constraint collapsed all of a user's pairs into one; the 2nd outbound/inbound connection raised DuplicateKeyError → 500. Fix: uniqueness moved to a scalar string pair_key = min(a,b)+'|'+max(a,b); startup migration drops the old array index and backfills pair_key on existing docs. Verified: u1→demo accept + u2→demo accept both return 200 and demo's accepted list contains both friends.
